answer.market_read: We are in the T-3 phase (2.88 h left), which is report-only, so I made no moves. No target is in play either: book, revenue and stars all have P(flip) of 0.0. Book: we lead SungJinho by 26.06 M and the projected end lead is 13.6 M on the 6 h fit and 11.2 M on the 12 h fit. They gain on us at about 4.2 M/h and would need 6.2 h to catch up. Revenue: we are 1.40 M ahead of SungJinho and 6.1 B behind inextro. Stars: we are 3rd at 4.48, .02 from rank 2 and rank 4. The OFF targets book_slope and book_projection are about the lead growing, not about keeping it, and the rule says to spend nothing on a decided part. The biggest fixable leak is still the kit's double-promise. Over the last 2 h, paid margin was 3.76 M/h against 4.68 M/h agreed. B pays only 49 of 93 closes (paid share .53: 6.2 M of B margin closed, 4.5 M paid). A pays 99 of 115 (.86) and C 35 of 35. settle_health shows 21 refusals out of 243 deals, 19 of them 'unit not in stock for this order'. A price knob cannot fix that. Refunds are 0.48 M/h against a .35 M/h target, which matches a B break rate of 6-10% and is not a new cause. The 11:33 per-SKU ask cuts are still inside their window to 13:33 (paid_margin_h, baseline 3.05 M/h). The 2 h paid margin of 3.76 M/h leans toward 'helped' but is not decided yet. The floor_mult 1.09 to 1.07 move is due about 12:30. The end-game code left everything as set: no buying stop beyond what is already running, and no move in this phase.
